scoring_justification: Full recompute of DFT energies from optimized structures requires running ORCA at the B3LYP/def2-SVP level, which is computationally heavy and not available in the lightweight verifier sandbox. Result-level comparison of the agent's reported relative ΔG values against paper-derived gold is feasible and appropriate.

hidden_assets.purpose: gold relative Gibbs free energies for FeD→FeH and FeD→FeSi
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Scheme 12 and 'Computational Investigations' section of the paper
hidden_assets.generation_method: extracted directly from the paper text and thermodynamic profile diagram
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the paper's own reported DFT results, used as the reproduction target.

schema.description: Standard XYZ format: first line number of atoms, second line comment (species name, charge, spin multiplicity), then lines with element symbol and x y z coordinates in Å. Multiple species are concatenated.

outputs.description: Optimized Cartesian coordinates of all catalytic intermediates; used by the checker to recompute energies.
Absolute and relative Gibbs free energies for the intermediates; the checker will independently recompute ΔG from the submitted structures.
Conclusion stating the more viable pathway (I or II) and the computed ΔG values; checked against the recomputed energies and paper-derived gold.

output_contract.notes: Scoring is based on the recomputed relative Gibbs free energies (ΔG) from the optimized structures, not on self-reported numbers alone. The verifier will run single-point energy + frequency calculations on the submitted XYZ files using ORCA to derive the reference energies.
